# Sora

Sora is a dark theme with ethereal cyan, cool silver and deep OLED blacks, aimed at crisp contrast and reduced eye strain. It follows the Sora colorscheme family, keeping UI accents subtle so attention stays on the notes.

![Sora screenshot](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/aejkatappaja/sora-obsidian/HEAD/screenshot.jpg)

```cue
theme: {
    name:   "Sora"
    author: "aejkatappaja"
    repo:   "aejkatappaja/sora-obsidian"
    slug:   "sora"

    html_url:       "https://community.obsidian.md/themes/sora"
    github_url:     "https://github.com/aejkatappaja/sora-obsidian"
    screenshot_url: "https://raw.githubusercontent.com/aejkatappaja/sora-obsidian/HEAD/screenshot.jpg"

    modes: ["dark"]
    about: "Apply a dark Obsidian theme with ethereal cyan, cool silver, and deep OLED blacks for crisp contrast and reduced eye strain. Use the Sora colorscheme family to keep UI accents subtle and keep focus on your notes."
}
```
